blockers: This is a single-language shard (Zig only). Cross-language common-basis recomputation of Semantic Density per capability_universe.json 'interaction_with_quality_metrics' requires merging all ten language shards; that merge is a runner-level obligation, not performed here.

Fragments above are worker-authored best-effort R10-style minimal forms rather than independently re-validated against the frozen toolchain recipe (V1 build/run evidence not executed in this packet-only environment); token counts and support levels are recorded as estimates pending mechanical re-validation.
metric.semantic_density.methodology: spec 6.1.3.A: raw value = explicit local semantic sites / lexical source tokens, computed over the measured_fragment of each of the 44 frozen probes. Only site rows whose evidence state is EXPLICIT_LOCAL for Zig contribute to the numerator. NONLOCAL/IMPLICIT/ABSENT/UNSUPPORTED rows do not enter the numerator. Tokens counted with a simple language-neutral punctuation/identifier/keyword/literal lexer; comments/whitespace excluded. Probes scored NONE for Zig contribute no tokens and no facts (excluded from this single-language basis; cross-language common-basis recomputation is a runner-level obligation once all ten language shards are merged).
